title: [CON2-9] The DM group ID is called `groupID` in some places and `mlsGroupID` in others
description: Review finding CON2-9: The DM group ID is called `groupID` in some places and `mlsGroupID` in others (lens CON2). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:150, :158. Fix: §4.6's DM `ChannelAdmissionKey` "carries `groupID`" and `DMMembers` body is `{"groupID": ...}`, while `DMGroupDescriptor` (04:166) and the compliance records use `mlsGroupID`. Rename the two JSON fields to `mlsGroupID`; keep the `<groupID>` URL path segment. Consistent with agora-channelid ("DMs named by group ID"). Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
